summary: Learn to use market evidence, MEB calculations and risk controls in CVA design. Build practical assurance tools for accountable transfers. Enrol today.
lede: Market-based cash and voucher assistance training is for humanitarian programme managers, CVA officers, MEAL teams and market analysts. It supports decisions about whether markets can meet demand and how to set and document transfer values, choose delivery mechanisms, and monitor price and supply changes. Participants also develop protection and complaints controls, payment checks, and review or exit actions using market evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who translate market evidence into cash or voucher decisions, assurance controls and programme reporting. It suits intermediate-level professionals working across humanitarian response and social-protection delivery.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of humanitarian programming, cash assistance or social-protection delivery is recommended. No coding or programming is required; basic spreadsheet familiarity supports the MEB and price-monitoring exercises.
